meta.title: Stoquify Founder Journey Preview
meta.description: A noindex concept preview for a founder-to-controlled-growth Stoquify landing experience.

hero.promise: From your first sale to controlled growth.
hero.copy: Build one operating record across sales, stock, purchasing, payments and accounting, then add regulated extensions only when their dependencies are ready.

problem.title: A business can grow faster than its operating record.
problem.description: When sales, stock, cash and accounting live in separate tools, the founder carries the explanation personally. Stoquify is designed to keep each decision connected to the source work behind it.

sales.title: Sales without a complete trail
sales.copy: A checkout event should still explain the payment, receipt, drawer, return and stock consequence.

stock.title: Stock without accountable movement
stock.copy: A quantity should remain tied to a location, count, transfer, receipt, adjustment or sale.

close.title: Close without source evidence
close.copy: A journal or balance should lead back to the operational event, responsible role and approval history.

journey.title: Build the operating foundation in four deliberate stages.
journey.description: Start with the work that creates the record. Add financial control and regulated extensions only after the source path is understood and ready.

foundation.title: Shape the operating model
foundation.copy: Define locations, roles, products, prices, approval responsibilities and the first workflows the business must control.
foundation.boundary: Scope, ownership and source data are confirmed during discovery.

operation.title: Run the core operation
operation.copy: Bring sales, POS, inventory, purchasing, receipts and payment capture into one source-linked path.
operation.boundary: Enabled modules and implementation readiness govern rollout.

control.title: Establish financial control
control.copy: Connect payment evidence, reconciliation, journals and OHADA-ready accounting to the work that produced them.
control.boundary: Country, accounting and provider readiness are qualified before activation.

growth.title: Grow with governed visibility
growth.copy: Extend into multi-branch oversight, HRIS, payroll, compliance and automation when their prerequisites are proven.
growth.boundary: Extensions retain entitlement, approval, privacy and release gates.

proof.title: Inspect the evidence, not a decorative mock-up.
proof.description: This approved, redacted product capture shows how a branch-close decision can carry source status, ownership and review context without exposing live tenant data.

source.title: Source-linked state
source.copy: Operational signals remain connected to the work and records that produced them.

owner.title: Named responsibility
owner.copy: Review context distinguishes who owns the next action without inventing automatic approval.

decision.title: Decision-ready evidence
decision.copy: The surface supports review and follow-up while preserving the underlying control boundary.

pathways.title: Choose the operating outcome before the module list.
pathways.description: Each pathway starts with a real buyer responsibility and ends with evidence that can be reviewed.

retail.title: Keep every branch sale accountable
retail.outcome: Connect checkout, tender, receipt, drawer and stock movement in one frontline path.
retail.proof: POS and continuity depend on enabled sales, inventory and approved device controls.

inventory.title: Explain stock and supplier commitments
inventory.outcome: Tie movements, counts, transfers, orders, receiving and payables to responsible work.
inventory.proof: Valuation and payable readiness remain dependent on complete source records.

finance.title: Carry operations into an explainable close
finance.outcome: Connect payment evidence, reconciliation, journals and OHADA accounting without losing provenance.
finance.proof: Accounting and close controls require reviewed configuration and complete periods.

leadership.title: See where control needs attention
leadership.outcome: Review branch signals, unresolved work and ownership without flattening every role into one dashboard.
leadership.proof: Visibility follows organization scope, permissions and active source paths.

trust.title: Growth should deepen the evidence, not weaken it.
trust.description: Stoquify's public promise stays within the controls the platform can prove: traceability, scoped access and qualified OHADA readiness.

traceability.title: Traceable operating history
traceability.copy: Material events retain source, actor, state and review context across the connected path.
traceability.boundary: Evidence quality still depends on complete source capture.

access.title: Scoped access and approval
access.copy: Tenant boundaries, permissions and controlled approvals determine who can view or act.
